title: Charging Session Failure Detection
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT bridges.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=evcharger:session
| stats count as sessions, sum(eval(status="faulted" OR status="interrupted")) as failed by charger_id
| eval fail_rate=round(100*failed/sessions,1)
| where failed>0
| sort - fail_rate
description: Counts charging sessions that faulted or stopped early per charger so you catch a flaky home charger or a bad cable before a morning with an empty battery.
value: A charge that silently fails overnight ruins your day; tracking failure rate per charger surfaces hardware problems while they are still cheap to fix.
implementation: Ingest charger session records; schedule daily and alert when a charger's failure rate climbs.
visualization: Table of chargers by failure rate with a trend.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when your car charger keeps stopping early, so you are not left with an empty battery in the morning.
